State entry precedes allocation. The NULL branch returns true before setup, counter reset and hitbox reset. Strict angle-normalization comparisons preserve the inclusive tau endpoint.

State-0 physics writes speed times cosine/sine of heading. State-1 animation obtains companion-driven position, and its separate physics callback resets velocity; the proposed phase distinction is supported.
Only the state-1 physics slot registers this callback. Its body solely resets velocity; state-0 collision enters state 1 before attempting companion allocation.

Ground clank cleanup returns true and clears both link directions without directly destroying the companion. The independently read air animation guard subsequently rejects a missing backlink and returns true.

The guarded air-helper call clears xDD8, followed by ground xDDC clearing. Effect destruction, xDE0 clearing and true return are unconditional. No synchronous companion destruction, state transition or timer initialization occurs in this callback.
